integrity.claim_to_evidence: The proof gives the exact Bernoulli product, Lucas parity count, binomial low-popcount estimate, Hilbert-space strong law and conditional martingale invariance principle. A separate finite verifier checks algebraic identities.

scientific_limitations: Independence across all time-cardinality blocks and a uniform nondegeneracy margin are assumed; optimality of assumptions is not claimed.
No quenched convergence rate or almost-sure pathwise bracket convergence is asserted.
Comparison with the 2026 primary manuscript is based on its accessible introduction, formal model and theorem table, not exhaustive full-text inspection.
title: Quenched Brownian limits for cardinality-tied randomized bootstrap walks
